sources.title: Adverse Weather and Health Plan
sources.facts: Supports preparation and response to heat, cold, flood and drought health risks.
sources.guard: A national plan does not prove local readiness, vulnerability or response performance.

sources.title: Health Effects of Climate Change report
sources.facts: Summarises direct and indirect health effects from heat, flooding, drought and other hazards.
sources.guard: National evidence does not predict exact-site health outcomes or event dates.

sources.title: Heat summary: drought and human health
sources.facts: Explains interactions among drought, heat, water quality, food supply and health.
sources.guard: Hazard mechanisms do not establish local drought status or individual health impact.

sources.title: Heat summary: wildfires and health
sources.facts: Explains increasing wildfire risk and health effects from smoke and compound heat hazards.
sources.guard: General risk evidence does not establish a specific fire, smoke plume or exposure.

sources.title: Climate change risk assessment and adaptation planning in your management system
sources.facts: Explains climate-risk assessment, control measures and adaptation plans for permitted sites.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove a site has completed an adequate assessment or remains compliant.

sources.title: 2025 drought: how it developed in England
sources.facts: Provides an official timeline and national graphics for the 2025 England drought.
sources.guard: A retrospective national report does not prove current or parcel-level water conditions.

sources.title: Dry weather and drought in England: 10 July to 16 July 2026
sources.facts: Records official dry-weather, environmental, navigation and water-resource conditions for that week.
sources.guard: A weekly summary is time-bounded and does not prove later or site-specific conditions.

sources.title: National Drought Group steps up response after third heatwave
sources.facts: Reports July 2026 heat, wildfire, water-demand and temporary-use-ban pressures.
sources.guard: A national update does not prove a specific site is in drought or subject to restrictions.
